messages:
leo-sales: Kestrel Bank POC ask — strict EU-only data residency, BYOK with HSM, and no US-based subprocessors for processing or telemetry. They're asking for a short runbook and delta pricing between Hosted+BYOK vs Dedicated+HSM for a 30-day POC (peak ~80 rps, ~400M tokens/month).

ina-legal: We can build an addendum restricting subprocessors to an explicit allow-list. Need to confirm which services count as subprocessors for them (monitoring, error reporting, analytics). Also will require DPA/GDPR clauses review.

ina-legal: Also flag: if customer requires zero-US subproc across our vendor supply chain, ops will need to replace some integrations for the POC. That may add time/cost.

vik-eng: Technically we can tenant-pin in EU and disable global failover for Hosted via routing_policy. For Dedicated and Private we can ensure compute and storage remain in-region. Example routing snippet we recommend:
```
{
  "routing_policy": "tenant_pin",
  "region": "eu-central-1",
  "allow_failover": false,
  "kv_cache_scope": "regional"
}
```
Note: if allow_failover=false autoscale bursts will also be constrained to same region which can affect cold-start latency.

ina-legal: Can ops confirm whether telemetry/observability pipelines use any US third-party endpoints by default?

maria-ops: Quick inventory: metrics go to EU Prometheus/Pushgateway in our eu cluster; traces forwarded to Tempo hosted in EU. Crashlytics/third-party error tracker is US by default on Hosted — we can disable for POC or route errors to customer's S3 in EU.

kevin-security: For BYOK/HSM: we support customer KMS (HSM) keys in eu-central-1 and can do key wrapping in-region. Remote on-prem HSM integration is possible but needs VPN/peering + CSR flow. Access to keys is restricted; we use ephemeral sessions and audit every key operation. We'll include an HSM integration checklist.

ina-legal: ETA for subprocessor appendix draft: 3 business days once ops confirms vendor list.

ina-legal: Also list requested from customer: which vendor they consider unacceptable, required retention windows, and whether they require certified EU-only employee access.

ina-legal: We'll also propose contractual language for no-US-subprocessor covenant limited to the POC timeframe with remediation/escrow terms.

ina-legal: Note: fully eliminating all indirect US dependencies may not be feasible for some cloud provider control plane services; we'll flag those in the appendix.

ina-legal: I'll need ops to provide explicit confirmations for the following buckets: compute, storage, logging, telemetry, backups, support tools.

maria-ops: Confirmed buckets and current defaults: compute (eu-central-1), storage (S3 eu-central-1), logs (forward to customer SIEM or EU storage), support tools (Zendesk is US by default). We can use EU-hosted ticketing or disable external support tools for POC.

leo-sales: Pricing: high-level ask — ballpark monthly delta for POC between Hosted+BYOK and Dedicated+HSM (with 30-day reserved burst).

ina-legal: I'll need the cost deltas to draft indemnities and SLA commitments tying to the pricing.

ina-legal: Also confirm retention and backup locations to set escrow terms.

ina-legal: Who owns egress cost if we route logs to customer's EU SIEM?

ina-legal: We'll put that as customer-responsibility unless we include egress credits in the quote.

ina-legal: Also note: if they want on-prem HSM, certificate exchange & network peering will be added as billable professional services.

ina-legal: Good to capture in the quote.

ina-legal: ops, can you give an ETA for HSM integration effort?

maria-ops: Rough estimate: Hosted+BYOK in-region: 12 weeks for config and test. Dedicated+HSM with on-prem HSM peering: 46 weeks including network setup and certs. PS hours ~ 120200 hrs depending on firewall rules.

ina-legal: thanks. That helps.

ina-legal: presales, please include those assumptions in the quote line items (PS, integration time).

ina-legal: presales, we also need a fallback policy if a scoped EU subprocessors later becomes unavailable mid-POC.

ina-legal: propose: notify customer + 7-day remediation window; if unresolved, pause POC and provide escrowed data export.

ina-legal: ops: can we produce a minimal runbook for the POC that lists which pipelines will be disabled / replaced to meet EU-only?

maria-ops: Yes. I'll create a "EU-only POC runbook" with exact toggles (disable crash reports, route logs to customer SIEM, enable EU-only vendor endpoints). ETA 48 hours.

ina-legal: presales, next steps for sales motion?

ina-legal: presales to produce two quotes (Hosted+BYOK, Dedicated+HSM) with explicit line items for PS, HSM setup, egress, and vendor substitution. Also attach the runbook and subproc appendix draft.

ina-legal: sales to send the draft appendix and runbook to customer for sign-off prior to any work.

leo-sales: OK — action list: 1) vik to export subproc inventory filtered to EU-only & flag exceptions (due Tue 10:00 CET) 2) maria to publish EU-only POC runbook and HSM PS estimate (due Wed EOD) 3) ina to produce price comparison quote with PS and assumptions (due Wed COB) 4) nina-legal to draft appendix and fallback text (due Thu). I'll loop customer after Tue. :thumbsup:
